description: Who was killed in drunk-driving crashes (a driver with BAC >= .08), with the drunk driver's own passengers separated from people outside that vehicle, for measured BAC only and for measured plus imputed BAC
method: Measured BAC = a test result in FARS person.ALC_RES (0-940 thousandths; 940 = .94 or greater); NHTSA's implicates fill untested drivers.  'measured only' counts a driver as BAC >= .08 only with a measured result >= .08 (observed counts, no imputation SE); 'all' / 'imputed' use the 10 implicates (mean, MI SE sqrt(1.1 * between-implicate variance))
inputs: FARS person (INJ_SEV, PER_TYP, AGE, SEX, LOCATION, STR_VEH)
